title: Give a modern slavery statement
what: Give the Minister a modern slavery statement for each reporting period once consolidated revenue reaches $100 million.

sources.title: Modern Slavery Act 2018
sources.quote: A reporting entity must give the Minister a modern slavery statement for the entity, for a reporting period, unless a modern slavery statement has been given covering the entity for that period under section 14 (joint modern slavery statements) or 15 (Commonwealth modern slavery statements).

triggers.unit: AUD consolidated revenue in the reporting period
